activities.name: Copy customer data along with their address

source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
    CONCAT_WS(' ', firstname, lastname) AS CustomerFullName,
    CA.addressId AS AddressID
FROM SalesLT.Customer AS C
INNER JOIN SalesLT.CustomerAddress AS CA
    ON C.customerid = CA.customerid
select count(*) as rc from saleslt.CustomerAddress

activities.description: Git practice: updated on feature branch

source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
    ConfigID,
    SourceSchema,
    SourceTable,
    IsActive,
    LoadType,
    LoadOrder
FROM dbo.ADF_TableConfig
WHERE IsActive = 1
ORDER BY LoadOrder;

SELECT LastWatermarkValue
FROM dbo.ADF_TableConfig
WHERE SourceSchema = 'dbo'
  AND SourceTable = 'Customer'
  AND IsActive = 1;

SELECT MAX(ModifiedDate) AS NewWatermark
FROM dbo.Customer;

scripts.text:
UPDATE dbo.ADF_TableConfig
SET LastWatermarkValue =
    (SELECT MAX(ModifiedDate) FROM dbo.Customer),
    UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME()
WHERE SourceSchema = 'dbo'
  AND SourceTable = 'Customer';
